name: 08_press_printer_button
title: Copying and Checking Printer Bed
summary: The robot presses a printer copy button, places an item inside the scanner, pans away to inspect a stand, and returns to retrieve the item.
robot: two white robotic arms with black dexterous hands
setting: an office or lab with a white table, a printer, and floor tape markings

source.original_prompt: Press the black and white copy button on the printer with the left arm

segments.instruction: Reach the left hand toward the button panel on the left side of the printer.
Press the copy button on the left panel with the left index finger, then retract slightly.
Lift the printer scanner lid with the left hand and place the small black item on the glass bed using the right hand.
Lower the scanner lid fully with the left hand to cover the glass bed.
segments.memory_event: hide: black item on the scanner glass is covered by the closed lid

segments.instruction: Turn the head camera to the left to look at the rolling stand and floor tape.
segments.memory_event: hide: printer and tabletop leave the field of view

segments.instruction: Keep looking at the rolling stand while lowering both hands toward the side.
Turn the head camera back to center on the table and printer.
segments.memory_event: return: tabletop, printer, closed lid, and cabling reappear as left

segments.instruction: Lift the scanner lid again with the left hand.
segments.memory_event: return: black item is visible on the scanner glass in its original position
